command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
[ -f "$change/proposal.md" ] || { echo "$record names change '$change_name', but $change/proposal.md does not exist - write the change there, or name the active change the task is about"; exit 1; }
verdict=$(sed -n 's/^Verdict:[[:space:]]*//p' "$record" | head -1)
if [ "$verdict" != "no-blocking-dependencies" ]; then
  echo "the change record's verdict is '$verdict'; the only verdict that finishes this stage is 'no-blocking-dependencies'."
  echo "If the change IS blocked, do not finish the round: write the dependency chain to the path in \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE as {\"question\": \"...\", \"options\": [\"...\"]}, delete $record and end your turn."
  exit 1
fi

findings.message: Handoff H1 (tasks.md 10.1, Human follow-up H1) amends an Accepted ADR in place: the patch adds a 'Cached copies of published data' paragraph to docs/adr/0004-local-persistence-strategy.md that changes its decision. ADR-0004 says 'Invalid data never crashes the app: the UI shows the error state with a reset action.' (line 57) and 'Writes are broadcast (BroadcastChannel, with the storage event as fallback); other tabs reload the changed document.' (line 65). .claude/rules/adr.md says 'Never edit an accepted ADR to change the decision — create a new one with `Superseded by ADR-YYYY`'. H1 should propose a new ADR (superseding or refining ADR-0004 for cached copies of published data) and design.md D2 / proposal 'What Changes' should refer to it. The silent discard (FR6, spec 'Stored release is unreadable … no error is shown') also departs from .claude/rules/architecture.md ('Invalid stored data leads to a recoverable error state, never a crash'), and no handoff item covers that rule.

Task 2.2 misdescribes its effect on packages/client/src/test/zoneRules/compile.stops.test.ts: the existing it.each at lines 134-145 asserts '2026fx' is rejected (run.urls empty), but replacing RELEASE_NAME = /^\d{4}[a-z]$/ with the release order pattern ^\d{4}[a-z]+$ (FR5) makes '2026fx' valid, so that case will fail. The task only says to add an 'aa' case and '2026A' (2026F is already covered); it must also say to change or remove the '2026fx' case (e.g. assert it passes the name check like '2026aa').
